Creates a new User object with the specified name and age.

This constructor initializes a new User object, ensuring the name is not null or empty and the age is a non-negative integer. It also provides a method to check if the user is an adult.

@param name (String): The name of the user, must not be null or empty.
@param age (int): The age of the user, must be a non-negative integer.
